title: MLHSM module registry
description: The catalog at the repository root. Lists every module offered to MLHSM. The per-module manifest stays the source of truth for a single module; this file is the index a browser renders without fetching anything else.

schema_version.description: Version of THIS schema. A client that does not recognise this value must refuse the catalog rather than guess.

updated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the last catalog change. Informational only - clients decide freshness from the file itself, never from this field.

moduleEntry.description: Summary of one module. Deliberately flat and small.

id.description: Stable identifier, must equal the id in the module manifest. Lowercase, digits and dashes.

display_name.description: How this installation wants the module called in the dashboard. Absent means the module's own `name` is shown. Presentation only, never a route or a permission.

author.description: Who publishes this module. A display value, never a trust anchor.

category.description: Grouping for the browser. Free-form so a third-party module never needs a core change to add a category.

manifest.description: Repository-relative path to the module manifest.

changelog.description: Repository-relative path to the module changelog.

release.description: Where the runnable artifact lives. Absent means metadata-only, not installable yet. MLHSM must not invent an artifact URL when this is missing.

url.description: Absolute https URL. A client must refuse anything else.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex digest of the asset. Required by CI once an asset is published.

mlhsm.description: Host compatibility. An incompatible range hides the module in the browser instead of failing later at install time.

api.description: Module API contract the module speaks.
